artBrief: **Quiet spring Japan.** A teapot, open book, and one cherry blossom at a sunlit desk. A compact still life with no tiny illegible page detail.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Quiet spring Japan. A teapot, open book, and one cherry blossom at a sunlit desk. A compact still life with no tiny illegible page detail. Peaceful compact Japanese still life: large ivory teapot, open book with blank pages, one pink cherry blossom on a sunlit wooden desk. Soft sage and warm cream, generous quiet background.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
